company_name: Nara Institute of Science and Technology, Solid-State Information Physics Laborator
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company specializes in advanced spectroscopic equipment relevant for semiconductor research and development.
summary: Nara Institute of Science and Technology's Solid-State Information Physics Laboratory focuses on developing compact, high-sensitivity electron energy analyzers for photoelectron spectroscopy. Their Retarding Field Analyzer (RFA) is designed for both laboratory and synchrotron applications, providing detailed analysis of local atomic structures and electronic band structures in semiconductor materials.
capabilities: Retarding Field Analyzer (RFA) for angle-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy (ARPES)
Photoelectron holography techniques for surface/interface observation
Local atomic structure analysis for semiconductor surfaces
